extra_hardware_compute_energy: unmeasured; 0.5 W idle is an existing engineering proxy
water_tracer: rain, surface-condensation, initial inventory; mixed evaporation/sliding per reservoir, CNF jumping condensation-first
energy_tracer: initial battery vs newly generated PV; mixed stored-energy attribution
coverage: complete jointly supported episodes plus common valid prefixes; never resume scoring an episode after first unsupported state
energy_to_water: whole-system modeled control burden divided by collected rain/condensation separately; overlapping ratios, not process-specific causal SEC
ratio_floor: 1e-4 kg/m2/hour * panel area * scored hours; ratios below this water amount are unresolved
RL_claim: no improvement claim without independent data and qualified model; new numerical weather holdout is not a physical experiment
uncertainty: separate numerical errors, scenario envelopes and city-cluster resampling; total physical uncertainty not calibrated
